top.line: Signed by the agent, vouched for by the person
top.para: Give every email agent its own key, vouched for by its person on pki.sgit.ai, and every draft can carry a signature and a QR code that lets the recipient check who signed, for whom, whether it still holds, and whether it changed.

in-short.line: Seven lines from the agent to the rule
in-short.para: Agents draft our email; each gets a key; each email carries a QR code; the check answers three questions; today's signatures prove less; the pieces exist; one official agent per person.

why.line: What changes when an agent writes your email
why.para: Our email agents draft and a person sends; recipients will ask who wrote it. As with the contractor's agent, the answer is an identity for the agent, vouched for by the person.

today.para: DKIM shows the message came through the domain's mail system, not who wrote it; S/MIME and PGP sign with a person's key but need software and trust most readers lack.

pieces.para: Session keys for agents; pki.sgit.ai's register with signed statements, evidence and two-way links; delegations that stop when withdrawn; sealed messages and QR codes.

how.line: How a signed email would work
how.para: The agent makes its key; the person delegates to it on pki.sgit.ai; the agent signs each draft with a link and a QR code; the person sends; the recipient's browser checks the signature, the delegation and the content.

verify.para: Who signed, on whose behalf, the delegation and whether it is listed, and whether the content matches; and what it cannot prove, such as that the person read it.

rules.para: One official email agent per person and address; the agent signs and the person sends; the person can co-sign; delegations expire; unsigned becomes a signal.

build.para: A delegation statement on pki.sgit.ai, signing in the email agents, a verification page, keys for each of us; first agent@diniscruz.ai, then RiskMandate, then the Web Summit team.

limits.para: A brief; a signature proves origin and integrity, not truth; it sits beside DKIM, S/MIME and PGP; recipients have to choose to check.

sources.para: My memo, pki.sgit.ai's llms.txt, and the related articles on email agents, keys and QR codes.
